analysis.narrativeEn:

· Bollinger Band Current Price Position (Lower Band $262.20): Approaching lower band, 22.07% band width indicates volatility expansion
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($276.92): Based on 20-day low, key defense level on decline
· Swing Resistance ($291.59): First resistance level on short-term rallies
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern: 5-day low ($278.46) > 20-day low ($276.92) suggests early Higher Low potential, but 5-day high ($304.97) < 20-day high ($331.43) confirms Lower High pattern
[Volume & Conclusion]

· Current Range Diagnosis: Downtrend persists, need to confirm support at 20-day low. Observing for support reaction.
